goals: Verify the order of method calls on the TimeService mock object.
activities: Initialize `timeVal` with the current local time.
Initialize `dateVal` with the current local date.
Initialize `dateTimeVal` with the current local date and time.
Configure `timeService.getTime()` to return the predefined time value.
Configure `timeService.getDate()` to return the predefined date value.
Configure `timeService.getDateTime()` to return the predefined date-time value.
Call `timeService.getTime()` and assert it returns the expected time value.
Call `timeService.getDate()` and assert it returns the expected date value.
Call `timeService.getDateTime()` and assert it returns the expected date-time value.
Create an `InOrder` verifier for the `timeService` mock.
Verify that `timeService.getTime()` was called in the correct order.
Verify that `timeService.getDate()` was called in the correct order.
Verify that `timeService.getDateTime()` was called in the correct order.
